coverage.note: README and annotations disagree on unique count. This subset covers all 10 tracking IDs present in the pinned annotations, not a verified set of 18 labels.

limitations: Synthetic label photos. Exploratory, not a held-out production evaluation. Scores the primary label tracking text and a separate first-Code128 baseline, not all neighboring labels, resident matching or mobile performance. Original photos exceed the app's 3 MB upload limit. No model training performed.
